snippet.title: BARKOUR | Gameplay Trailer | TOKYO Game Show 2025
snippet.description:
🐾 Villains beware: Agent T.H.U.N.D.E.R. has been unleashed!

Step into the paws of a four-legged secret agent in Barkour – a fast-paced mix of stealth, action, and dog parkour. Glide across rooftops, sneak past enemies, and unleash hi-tech gadgets to stop a web of evil schemes.

This first gameplay trailer showcases the heart of Barkour: thrilling stealth sequences, acrobatic parkour stunts, and gadget-powered combat – all with the playful charm of Agent T.H.U.N.D.E.R. From perilous greenhouses to shady amusement parks, get a taste of the diverse missions awaiting you.

🎮 Demo available on October 2, 2025!
Wishlist now and be among the first to play:
👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/1920290/Barkour/
